connect.title: Connect dazero to your AI
connect.subtitle: It works with any agent that speaks MCP. Pick the way that suits you.

auto.s2: Paste it into your AI — Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, whichever you use.
auto.s3: It connects to dazero and asks you to sign in. That's it.
auto.note: Nothing to install here: the sign-in happens in your agent, and no API key ever leaves this page.

mcp.lead: One address for every host. Add it as a remote MCP server and complete the sign-in it opens.

cli.lead: For a terminal. Same account, same brands — useful for scripts and CI, not needed to use dazero from an agent.
cli.note: The CLI and the local MCP server share one session, so signing in once covers both.

connect.copiedBig: Copied — now paste it to your AI

video.title: Images & video
video.clipLengthDesc: Fixed length for every generated clip, or Auto so chat / batch generation picks a length per reel from the spoken script. Billed per second. The longest option depends on the video model above; clips shorter than 10s cannot carry a hook, a point and a call to action.
video.instructionsDesc: How the person on camera should perform: tone, energy, accent, what to never do. Steers the clip itself — captions are set per platform.
video.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Speak fast and informally, like talking to a friend. Never sound like an ad. Italian accent, no corporate jargon.
video.resolutionDesc: 480p is recommended: 720p costs exactly double per second, and every clip is billed whether or not you publish it. On a phone feed the difference is small.

slots.imageGenerateDesc: Which model draws a new photo from a prompt. The default is GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst, about a tenth of the previous cost at the same speed. Nano Banana, Seedream and Qwen run on kie: slower, and Seedream and Qwen frame Instagram posts at 3:4 instead of 4:5.
slots.imageRefineDesc: Which model edits a photo that already exists — adding a logo, restyling, changing one detail. Reproducing an image faithfully is a different job from inventing one, and the best family at one is not always the best at the other. Empty follows the generation model.
slots.videoGenerateDesc: Which model writes a clip from words alone. Clip length options follow this pick — Seedance 2.5 goes to 30 seconds.
slots.videoAnimateDesc: Which model animates a still that already exists, usually the rendered cover. Empty follows the video generation model, which is what every brand had before this split.
slots.videoRefineDesc: Which model rewrites a finished clip — swapping a subject, changing the setting or the styling — while keeping the original motion. Only models that read a video appear here.
slots.videoMotionDesc: Which model takes the movement from a reference video and applies it to a subject in your image. Not the same as motion videos, which are rendered from code and use no generative model.
